def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((c for c in range(w) if 2 * c + 1 == w and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep is None:
        raise ValueError("No centered vertical separator")
    left = [grid[r][:sep] for r in range(h)]
    right = [grid[r][sep + 1:] for r in range(h)]
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    if len(shared) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one shared panel color, got {shared}")
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == color and right[r][c] == color else color for c in range(sep)] for r in range(h)]
